propositions: Bedrock Guardrail and Anthropic content-policy blocks are normalized to finish_reason=content_filter and classified as CHANGE_INPUT (correct disposition), but the operator message incorrectly says 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the content-policy block as root cause.

The message_for() function must accept an optional finish_reason keyword parameter; when resolution_class=CHANGE_INPUT and finish_reason=content_filter, it returns a distinct message naming the guardrail/content filter block rather than the generic size/format message.
Non-content-filter CHANGE_INPUT cases (HTTP 413, context-length exhaustion) continue to receive the existing generic message; finish_reason threading must not over-broaden the content-filter branch.

The fix is messaging-only: resolution_class, retryable flag, exit-code mapping, and telemetry behavior remain unchanged; finish_reason is already available in LLMOutcome.diagnostic and persisted coverage diagnostic, so it must be threaded through all three call sites.
